title: Roasted Vegetables with Verde Sauce
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make recipe featuring roasted vegetables smothered in a tangy verde sauce.
instructions: Place the chopped onion and minced garlic on a baking sheet.
Toss the sliced zucchinis and bell peppers with a little bit of oil and spread them on a separate baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat the shortening over medium heat.
Add the verde sauce and stir to combine.
Add the roasted vegetables to the skillet and toss to coat with the verde sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
